channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Trump orders limits on birthright citizenship, targets 'birth tourism'
item.description: President Trump on Thursday signed two executive orders again aimed at restricting birthright citizenship, an apparent attempt to circumvent a recent Supreme Court ruling that upheld the constitutional protection. item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Experts advise caution as multiple produce-borne outbreaks surge across the US
item.description: Jalapeños are the latest produce to raise concern with health officials, who are now tracking a salmonella outbreak in several states.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for August 6
item.description: Here are the top headlines from the day, from here in Tampa Bay and around the world. Tampa Bay 28 Chief Meteorologist Denis Phillips gives Florida's most accurate forecast.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man charged with arson in Washington, told police he planned wildfire for weeks
item.description: A man charged with starting one of the wildfires in Spokane, Washington, that have destroyed hundreds of buildings planned the crime for weeks and researched when the weather would be best for igniting it, police said.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hurricane forecast update: Is the government prepared for the rest of the season?
item.description: Meteorologists and scientists have raised concerns about major federal cuts to hurricane-related weather agencies over the last year or so. NOAA and the NHC say they're ready to work.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Crews remove the granite seal on the White House helipad, signaling potential project delays
item.description: Construction crews have torn apart the granite presidential seal on the new White House helipad — and no one's saying why. What do you think is going on? 👇

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meta says its AI model hacked another company due to 'misconfiguration'
item.description: Meta said Thursday that one of its artificial intelligence models accessed the internet on its own and hacked another company, the latest in a series of disclosures about AI models going rogue.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bay Crest Park residents say proposed short-term rental ordinance doesn't go far enough
item.description: Hillsborough County commissioners voted 7-0 to move a proposed short-term rental ordinance toward a public hearing. Residents of Bay Crest Park in Hillsborough County say it does not go far enough.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Emergency management director fired over 'pattern of coercive and intimidating conduct': Hillsborough County
item.description: Hillsborough County confirmed the dismissal of OEM Division Director Timothy Dudley after an investigation.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump signs executive orders targeting birthright citizenship
item.description: President Trump signed two executive orders aimed at what his administration calls "birth tourism," including one that seeks to expand the categories of people ineligible for birthright citizenship.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] More than 900 million SpaceX shares unlock today. Here’s what to know
item.description: More than 900 million SpaceX shares just unlocked — here's what that means for investors and the stock's future. 👇

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Florida man pleads guilty to $14M fraudulent check scheme: DOJ
item.description: A 69-year-old Florida man pleaded guilty to a $14 million fraudulent check scheme on Thursday, according to the U.S. Department of Justice.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bella's celebrates 40 years; takes part in movie production
item.description: Bella's Italian Cafe has two big reasons to celebrate this summer: first, they marked their 40th anniversary, and then they were asked to participate in a movie.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump pushes back on reports of munitions shortages, denies any frustration with Hegseth
item.description: President Trump is pushing back on reports of possible munitions shortages as the war in Iran goes on. Trump has suggested that statements about shortages may be 'treasonous.'

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] MyPillow CEO Mike Lindell steps down to focus on Minnesota governor's race
item.description: Mike Lindell is stepping down as CEO of MyPillow to focus on his campaign to become Minnesota's next governor.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man gets 25-year prison sentence for Temple Terrace kidnapping, sexual battery of teen girl: SAO
item.description: The man behind the abduction and sexual battery case that left Temple Terrace on edge in March received his prison sentence on Thursday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Catching Rays with Victor Mesa Jr.
item.description: Kyle and Victor Mesa Jr. had “Catching Rays” conversation about Mesa Jr.’s Cuban roots, his famous father, and how he brings the good vibes to the Rays clubhouse.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] McConnell released from rehabilitation center, will continue recovery at home
item.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell was discharged from a rehabilitation center Thursday and will continue recovering at home after a fall earlier this summer.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Manatee County Superintendent talks about new schools and safety
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 anchor Lauren St. Germain spoke with Manatee County Superintendent Dr. Laurie Breslin, who is entering her second school year as superintendent.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Clear bag policy implemented at Plant City High School
item.description: At Plant City High School, students will return to campus with a new rule after several gun incidents at the end of last school year.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] UEFA maintains demand for FIFA president's resignation, threatens World Cup boycott
item.description: European soccer's governing body isn't backing down. UEFA is threatening to boycott the World Cup and demanding FIFA's president resign. What do you think happens next? 👇

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough County School District prepares to head back to school
item.description: Hillsborough County public schools hosted a back-to-school kickoff on Wednesday. They welcomed educators, district leaders, and students ahead of the first day of school.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Kellogg to eliminate artificial colors, BHT from cereal lineup
item.description: Kellogg said Wednesday its cereals, including Froot Loops and Apple Jacks, will be free of artificial colors and the preservative BHT by the end of the year.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New poll reveals how extreme heat is changing Americans' lives
item.description: A new AP-NORC poll finds that Americans are increasingly noticing the impact of extreme heat on their lives, and they say much of that shift is happening in the West and Midwest.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Andrei Vasilevskiy visits Tampa Bay Lightning goalie camp to inspire young goaltenders
item.description: The 2-time Vezina Trophy winner signed autographs and offered encouragement to the next generation of goaltenders at the Tampa Bay Lightning Goalie Camp.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] More than 1.7 million attic stairway ladders recalled due to fall risk
item.description: The Consumer Product Safety Commission has issued a recall for specific attic stairway ladders due to fall risk.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Buc-ee’s lawsuit against Ohio mini mart sparks social media firestorm
item.description: An Ohio carryout is facing a trademark lawsuit from Buc-ee’s over its beaver logo, drawing support from local and state officials.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FCC repeals national TV ownership cap, a win for Trump-aligned broadcasters
item.description: The FCC voted on Thursday to remove the cap on TV station ownership in the U.S., delivering a big win to media companies aligned with President Donald Trump and the Republican Party.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] St. Pete police issue statement on Flock camera usage
item.description: St. Pete police Chief Holloway issued a statement on Flock cameras after comments online circulated about police usage.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Three charged with threatening judge, those tied to Nolan Wells investigation
item.description: Three people have been charged with threatening a judge, a witness and local officials connected to the investigation into the death of Nolan Xavier Wells.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Teen charged in Davis Islands dog park attack pleads guilty
item.description: A teenager pleaded guilty Thursday in connection with a violent attack at the Davis Islands Dog Park in Tampa.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough County unveils district’s first hospitality magnet school at Jefferson High
item.description: Jefferson High School is officially the district's first Magnet School of Hospitality and Tourism.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough County commissioners vote to draft one-year data center pause
item.description: The Hillsborough County Commission took the first step toward a moratorium blocking the controversial data centers until their impact on communities and the environment can be studied.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Traumatic car crash led one woman to discover healing through painting
item.description: After a life-changing car accident, Diana Pepper found healing in the most unexpected places.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Florida Southern College turns citrus groves into 'living laboratories' to help rescue state's industry
item.description: Florida Southern College has planted 45 young citrus trees across its Lakeland campus to create a hands-on living laboratory aimed at helping growers revitalize Florida's struggling citrus industry.
